555.title: Show how many invoices an export will include
555.body:
## Problem

Customers start exports without knowing their size.

## Scope

Show a count of invoices before an export starts.

## Verification

- A component test shows the count.

556.title: Round cents half to even
556.body:
## Problem

Finance's ledger rounds half to even; the portal rounds half up.

## Scope

Round half to even in `roundCents`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows 2.5 rounding to 2 and 3.5 to 4.

558.title: Credit notes are charged tax
558.body:
## Problem

A negative amount produced negative tax.

## Scope

Return 0 tax for a zero or negative amount.

## Verification

- A unit test shows a credit note owes no tax.

560.title: Show the export size before it starts
560.body:
Adds an export summary with the invoice count.

Closes #555

## Verification

- The count shows: `tests/views/export-summary.test.ts` passed.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
